posts.text: Results were good. What concerned me was how the management responsed then investores grilled on the “Goodluck defence.” Their standard response was that their advisors had recommended the same approach . I am sure the management understood what they were doing and the potential impact it could have on minority shareholders. I’m not sure, however, whether the grilling will actually make them reconsider or reverse their current course. posts.author: pranavpallod12
posts.community: Goodluck India Ltd - Will it bring Good Luck for us?
posts.text: Operating performance by Goodluck in Q1 was perfection. But the management has clouded the sentiments around the company with their actions regarding capital decisions in the defense subsidiary. Let’s hope the grilling by shareholders in concall makes them alter their course. Opertionally, future looks bright for next 2-3 years for the company. Share price returns will come down to management actions around the defense subsidiary. DISCLOSURE: INVESTED.
